details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py:30, 73, 89, 143, 192 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The regex-based test helper still searches scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh for _reap_editor_fifo_holders after the function moved to scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh, so the four extraction tests fail to find it.
  WHY: All three reviewers report the same "function _reap_editor_fifo_holders() not found" CI failure after the extraction moved.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:~3477-3501 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The write_guard_check step runs after the .github/workflows cleanup block, so workflow edits are restored to HEAD before the guard can detect and block them.
  WHY: When ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=false, the cleanup silently discards workflow changes before the guard evaluates conditional_blocked_globs for .github/workflows/**.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh:~158 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The write_guard_check call is placed after the ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS cleanup/restore path, so it sees a sanitized tree instead of the editor's workflow edits.
  WHY: With ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=false, workflow changes are discarded before the guard runs, defeating enforcement of the workflow-file policy.
- scripts/write_guard.sh:119-121 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Malformed write_guard config JSON can raise an unhandled json.JSONDecodeError from json.loads(...), exposing a generic exception path instead of a controlled guard failure.
  WHY: The helper reads .github/ai/write_guards.v1.json directly, so invalid JSON can surface uncaught decode errors and leak implementation details.
- scripts/write_guard.sh:66-85 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: Python subprocess parse failures exit with code 2 and print a bare exception message, violating the shell helper's intended 0/1 diagnostic contract.
  WHY: The workflow wrapper expects structured guard diagnostics, but the helper currently emits a nonstandard exit code and noisy stderr that can confuse consumers.
- .workflow-templates workflows including new label-sync wrapper:ai-sync-labels.yml workflow lacks a concurrency group declaration | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The new label-sync workflow omits a unique concurrency group, allowing overlapping runs.
  WHY: The reviewer says consumer deployments firing on repository_dispatch while workflow_dispatch tasks are running can clobber shared state without a unique non-overridable concurrency group.
- scripts/write_guard.sh:83-103 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: When write_guard_config_path is missing, the helper falls through the Python exit-code-2 path without emitting a controlled sentinel message.
  WHY: The shell wrapper's 0/1/2 contract is not robust here, so callers cannot reliably distinguish a blocked path from an internal error.
- tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py:439-451, 1520, 1547 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: _copy_write_guard_assets copies scripts/write_guard.sh and .github/ai/write_guards.v1.json into the fixture repo without git add, leaving them untracked.
  WHY: The reviewer notes those untracked files can affect candidate-path enumeration and test determinism if the guard's resolution logic changes.
- tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py:~1535, ~1562 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Adding env=_isolated_test_env(cwd=repo_dir) to the git status subprocess calls may break if the helper does not forward required environment variables.
  WHY: The reviewer says the change likely matches the established isolation pattern, but if _isolated_test_env omits PATH or other git prerequisites the subprocess could fail.
- scripts/review_commit_changes.sh (and the new write_guard.sh): import of write_guard.sh + call to write_guard_check | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The guard's naming and surrounding terminology still imply a purely destructive-commit check even though it now also blocks plan-time changes and conditional workflow edits.
  WHY: The behavior has broadened, so the old label is misleading even though runtime behavior is unchanged.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Update tests that extract _reap_editor_fifo_holders to look in scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh instead of scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py (update SCRIPT constant or add logic to search watchdog_helpers.sh)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  EVIDENCE: The LAST RUN DIFF modifies tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py but does not touch tests/test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py. The PR CHANGED FILES list does not include test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py, but it must be updated to reference the new location of the extracted function.
- requirement: The original PR intent (squash of orchestrator project #3408) was to land the complete "squad-workflow improvements" (N1, P5a, P5b, N2, N4) including the new write-guard policy, repo_learnings extraction, shared watchdog/codex helpers, label-sync workflow, consumer-drift audit, and memory schema update.
  expected_change_site: All files listed in PR CHANGED FILES (esp. write_guard.sh + its integration in implement/plan/review/validate workflows + test coverage)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The LAST RUN DIFF only touches the ordering of the write_guard_check in implement.yml and the test fixtures. The core write_guard.sh implementation, most of the cross-workflow wiring (clarify/plan/validate), the new tests (test_write_guard.sh, test_audit_consumer_drift.py, test_memory_record_schema.py), and the label-sync/audit workflow wrappers were already present from previous passes. The only remaining gap is that review_apply_fixes.sh still imports the old inline functions instead of sourcing the extracted watchdog_helpers.sh consistently, causing the failing CI lint job.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- tests/test_review_editor_fifo_drain.py:30 (SCRIPT = REPO_ROOT / "scripts" / "review_apply_fixes.sh"), lines 73, 89, 143, 192 (calls to _extract_function("_reap_editor_fifo_holders")) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test module uses _extract_function to locate the definition of _reap_editor_fifo_holders inside scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh via regex matching, but the function was extracted into scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh.
  WHY: The test's SCRIPT constant still points to review_apply_fixes.sh, so the regex never matches and four tests fail with "function _reap_editor_fifo_holders() not found in .../scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh".
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/write_guard.sh:119-121 | severity not stated | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Missing JSON decoding error handling for malformed configuration raises a generic Exception, which is not caught in the set +e block.
  WHY: This path can throw json.JSONDecodeError on invalid JSON in .github/ai/write_guards.v1.json, and unhandled it could surface internal error details to consumers of the helper.
- scripts/write_guard.sh:66-85 | severity not stated | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On parse errors inside the Python subprocess, the script exits with code 2 and prints the bare exception message to stderr, violating the intended failure signal protocol.
  WHY: The invoking shell script expects zero/one exit codes with diagnostics, not diagnostic exit codes from the helper.
- .workflow-templates workflows including new label-sync wrapper:ai-sync-labels.yml workflow lacks a concurrency group declaration | severity not stated | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: New workflows committed to workflow-templates/ should define a unique non-overridable concurrency group, but this one omits it.
  WHY: Consumer deployments using this template that fire on repository_dispatch while workflow_dispatch tasks are running risk clobbering the ai-memory branch or state files.
- scripts/write_guard.sh:83-103 | severity not stated | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When write_guard_config_path file lookup misses and returns empty, the Python path still captures missing-config text and returns “!” via the exit code 2 path anyway.
  WHY: No controlled sentinel message is written for the shell script to apply set +e cleanup or fallback grace.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh:10-72 | severity not stated | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The codex_config_assemble public API third positional argument named “verbosity” is unused by the implementation and kept only for positional-parity with legacy call-sites.
  WHY: Calling code that bundles third positional “verbosity” values implicitly passes them into the shared writer, which then ignores it.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
